cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
cards.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I only finished one painting for our exhibition. Tell me I've done enough.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll spread mine out. Nobody will notice the gap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I need to know I've contributed, not that you can hide where I haven't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours belongs in the middle. It's the one people will see first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then introduce me as the other painter. No 'despite everything'. I want to hear that I belong here.
